scope: Make the shared signed synthesis worker enforce its own task registry before request lookup or source access.

pytest.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_migration.py tests/test_agent_worker_cli.py tests/test_agent_worker_draft.py tests/test_capital_efficiency.py tests/test_bio_factory_operations.py tests/test_regenerative_outcomes.py tests/test_synthesis_source_references.py -q

limits: The runtime check establishes code-level registry enforcement only; it does not prove process deployment identity or least-privilege database grants.
Non-synthesis task execution remains unsupported by the signed synthesis worker and is rejected before receipt lookup or source DB access.
